title: What do you think of this Steam capsule?
author: Roma2443
selftext:
​

Do you like this capsule art?

Would you be interested in learning more?

This is for an RTS that can be played in two very different ways:

either as a highly challenging competitive experience, or as a more relaxed solo/co-op extraction mode.
